lines.en: I step out of the void.

lines.zh: 我的身体压得空间作响
lines.en: My bulk makes space creak.
My six limbs come down in turn.
I close on the living, slowly.
Fragments of the void trail after me.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，光就暗一分
lines.en: Each step dims the light a little more.

lines.zh: 我的尾在身后划出一道痕
lines.en: My tail scores a line behind me.
I stride across a rift in the void.
My wings scrape the void.
I walk very slowly, and very heavily.
I halt in this emptiness.

lines.zh: 这里没有风，也没有声音
lines.en: No wind here, and no sound.
I spread my limbs and breathe slowly.

lines.zh: 我记得自己被丢在这里
lines.en: I remember being cast into this place.

lines.zh: 虚空把我当作它的孩子
lines.en: The void treats me as its child.
The cracks in me glow.
I am gathering, waiting.

lines.zh: 有东西在这片空里漂过
lines.en: Something drifts through this emptiness.

lines.zh: 我不急，时间在这里很慢
lines.en: No hurry. Time moves slowly here.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，天上没有东西
lines.en: I look up; there's nothing in the sky.

lines.zh: 我的肢体收拢，像在抱什么
lines.en: My limbs fold as if cradling something.
This void is my nest.
I breathe out; it's black.
I listen for anything living.
My brood isn't here.

lines.zh: 我静静地亮着，像块残渣
lines.en: I glow quietly, like a scrap of debris.
You actually made it here.
I lower my head and look at you up close.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，还敢抬头
lines.en: So small, and you still look up.
The light on you is glaring.

lines.zh: 我在虚空的裂缝里看你。
lines.en: I watch you through a crack in the void.
My limbs have already closed around.
You don't scream. Good.
I can count your heartbeats.
Have you come here to die?
This void has no room for you.

lines.zh: 我看了很久，才决定不动
lines.en: I watch a long while before deciding not to move.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就当你怕了
lines.en: One step back and I'll count you afraid.
I draw back; my cracks deepen.

lines.zh: 这一下让我停顿了一息
lines.en: That gave me pause for a breath.
One segment of my limb has failed.
Black blood drips and smokes.
I growl, and the void shudders.
I'll remember this small wound.
I adjust my stance.
Pain is a rare thing here.
You struck an old wound.
I'm still here. Not enough yet.

lines.zh: 在这个地方，食物没有意义
lines.en: Here, food has no meaning.

lines.zh: 虚空里当母亲，看你手抖。
lines.en: A mother in the void watches your hands shake.

lines.zh: 我闻不到那东西的味道
lines.en: I can't smell that thing at all.
Argent isn't enough to fill my teeth.
I extend a limb and push it aside.

lines.zh: 这具身体早就不是靠吃活的
lines.en: This body stopped feeding long ago.
What you brought is too slight.
Your offering is too light.
Keep it. It may be of use.
Don't test me with this.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，退了很远
lines.en: You hit me and fall far back.

lines.zh: 我的身体比看上去更硬
lines.en: I'm harder than I look.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，你也没推动
lines.en: I didn't move, and neither did you push me.
One of my limbs sweeps past you.

lines.zh: 这地方太窄，容不下我们
lines.en: This place is too small for both of us.
Stay against me and you'll freeze.
I shift a little. Not to make way.
The void's edge is behind me.
One touch should tell you enough.
Back off. I don't wish to move yet.
I am the only mother here.

lines.zh: 我的子嗣不在这个位面
lines.en: My brood is not in this plane.
To stay, you'd have to become me.
The void has no need to breed.
I've been alone here a long time.
Don't call me by that word.
You are only a passerby.
I won't remember your name.
Go. I don't take in anyone.
You've lived longer than I expected.
I pinch it up on a limb's tip.

lines.zh: 在我手里，它一下就碎了
lines.en: In my grip it crumbles at once.
This can't withstand my touch.
I drop it into the void.
I keep it as a marker.
I've nowhere to put things.
I look at it and set it down.
This amounts to nothing.
I press it into the ground.
Take it. I don't want it.
Something living has entered the void.
I raise my head and lock on.
Its light is tiny in my eyes.
I spread all my limbs.
The rules here are mine.
The ground it stands on is giving way.
I move forward slowly.
It has no way back.
Your warmth reaches me.
This is the offering I want.
I open my mouth, very wide.
From now on, it is mine.
I press down and space warps.
It can't run now.
My shadow swallows it first.
I raise my forelimbs.
The void moves with me.
It begins.
I haven't sped up at all.
It goes left; the left collapses.
I needn't chase. The void encircles.
Its breathing is ragged.
I extend a limb above its head.
Space folds at my side.
I see its every step.
It starts to scream.
That sound is pleasing.
I shift my weight forward.

lines.zh: 虚空在我脚下裂开一道缝。
lines.en: The void splits open under my feet.
It's at the very edge now.
I'm slow. It's slower.
Only the two of us remain here.
I open my mouth and inhale.
It's being dragged in.
Almost.
In the void, I've waited a long time.
I close my limbs.
You have nowhere to go.
I bring a limb down.
It's smashed into the ground.
My jaws close on it.
The void's strength runs through me.
I fling it away.

lines.zh: 它的骨头在我口里碎了
lines.en: Its bones break in my mouth.
I put my whole weight down.
There was nothing wasted in that blow.
It's still moving. I strike again.
A limb tip pierces it.
Darkness seeps into the wound.
I raise my head; blood drips.
The void is quiet again.
My claws sink into the stone seams.
No mourning, and no hatred.
I only did what I do.
The void splits, and I come through.
I land, and the ground sinks.

lines.zh: 这地方没有可以参照的东西
lines.en: There's nothing here to take bearings by.
I unfold my body, slowly.
The void's stone is splitting.

lines.zh: 我想起自己是从哪来的
lines.en: I remember where I came from.
My cracks flare for an instant.

lines.zh: 这里有一点点活物的气味
lines.en: There's the faintest smell of something alive.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，找到一个方向
lines.en: I raise my head and find a direction.
The void follows behind me.
I make a sound, very low.

lines.zh: 这个位面比我记得的亮
lines.en: This plane is brighter than I remember.
I begin to move, slowly.
All other sounds recede.
My being here is enough.
Something is waiting for me.
I'll go and see what it is.
I take my first step out of the void.
I have come.
This place will be mine.

lines.zh: 火在我身上烧，像在烧石头
lines.en: Fire burns on me as if on stone.

lines.zh: 我从高处坠下，砸出裂口
lines.en: I fall from a height and crack the ground.
Water shouldn't exist in this place.
The blast scatters my limbs.

lines.zh: 一枚弹片嵌进了我的壳
lines.en: A shard lodges in my shell.

lines.zh: 这股术力想把我推出去
lines.en: This spell tries to force me out.

lines.zh: 太久没有祭品，我在萎缩
lines.en: Too long without an offering; I'm withering.
Lightning runs through my cracks.

lines.zh: 连我也被虚空吞了一点
lines.en: Even I am partly swallowed by the void.
